package.name: yam_description
package.description: URDF / xacro description of the I2RT YAM 6-DoF arm with its interchangeable grippers (linear_4310, crank_4310, none), plus ros2_control and MoveIt joint-limit configuration. Kinematics, inertials and meshes come from the MIT-licensed i2rt repository (https://github.com/i2rt-robotics/i2rt).
